title: Company
description: A company registered by a user. userId is the current owner and may be reassigned; companyWalletAddress is fixed and always names the wallet that created the record.

companyId.description: The company's id, of the form company_<22 url-safe characters> (primary key). Server-assigned on create; a value in a create body is ignored.

userId.description: The wallet address of the user who owns the company. Reassigning it transfers ownership.

companyWalletAddress.description: The wallet address that created the company. Immutable — a request that changes it is refused.

email.description: Contact email. Checked for shape, never verified by a round-trip.

logo.description: URL to the company logo. Set by the logo endpoint.

summary.description: What the company does, as one free-text block

address.description: Registered address, as one free-text block

permission.description: Per-role clearance for the company. Admin-only to write. No investor or spv role: those belong to a natural person.

createdAt.description: When the company was first stored. Server-assigned.

updatedAt.description: When the company last changed. Server-assigned.
